assumptions.statement: Exact official site and key-area polygons are unavailable; repository provisional geometry is used only for deterministic generation and directional intake review.
assumptions.impact: All nine geometry layers, six spatial metrics, and display artifacts require coordinated recalculation when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory land use, FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, and development controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The proposal completes the expression method but keeps statutory controls unknown.

assumptions.statement: No cleared survey of existing buildings, condition, structure, ownership, or heritage status is connected.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints are repairable concept prototypes and cannot support parcel-specific retain-renovate-demolish conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Road sections, crossings, rail integration, parking supply, bicycle parking, traffic counts, and accessibility field measurements are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Mobility geometry expresses conceptual continuity and repair access only.

assumptions.statement: Power, cooling, water, drainage, telecom, compute, fire, and municipal capacities are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No capacity, engineering feasibility, savings, or C3 expansion claim is made.

assumptions.statement: Project-specific heritage, park, river-blue-line, green-control, archaeology, and protected-view constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Landmark and public-space placement remains directional and subject to specialist review.

assumptions.statement: No official or field-validated civic asset inventory, inspection history, fault record, spare-parts record, or maintenance backlog is connected.
assumptions.impact: The maintenance-debt map and asset registry are synthetic demonstrations only.

assumptions.statement: Operators, legal authorities, staffing, service hours, procurement lots, partners, and annual event commitments are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Actors are defined as roles; activities are conceptual operating proposals.

assumptions.statement: Renewal escrow ratio, custodian, currency, accounting, legal vehicle, and release conditions have not been professionally established.
assumptions.impact: The executed example uses synthetic_reserve_unit and cannot be read as a real fund.

assumptions.statement: Eight personas are inclusive design hypotheses rather than demographic or behavioral findings.
assumptions.impact: Field research must use consent, data minimization, accessibility review, and non-digital participation.

assumptions.statement: Seven global cases have different law, governance, land, finance, climate, and technical conditions.
assumptions.impact: Only mechanisms are transferred; quantitative results and institutional forms are not copied.

assumptions.statement: The Node closure test and sixteen simulation tasks are executed and reproducible but synthetic, not field validated, and not connected to official systems.
assumptions.impact: Results prove deterministic rule behavior, not site performance or engineering readiness.

assumptions.statement: Bilingual figures, offline visual HTML, and composed A3/A0 PDFs have been deterministically generated and content-checked.
assumptions.impact: The package remains scaffold; frozen scaffold SHA claims will mismatch modified existing artifacts until finalization, and no persisted four-gate or review-ready state is claimed.
